46: /// Calculate checksum
47: ///
48: /// # Arguments
49: ///
50: /// * `options` - CLI options for the assigning checksum algorithm
51: /// * `files` - A iterator of OsStr which is a bunch of files that are using for calculating checksum
52: #[allow(clippy::cognitive_complexity)]
53: #[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]
54: fn cksum<'a, I>(mut options: Options, files: I) -> UResult<()>
55: where
56:     I: Iterator<Item = &'a OsStr>,
57: {
58:     let files: Vec<_> = files.collect();
59:     if options.output_format == OutputFormat::Raw && files.len() > 1 {
60:         return Err(Box::new(ChecksumError::RawMultipleFiles));
61:     }
62: 
63:     for filename in files {
64:         let filename = Path::new(filename);
65:         let stdin_buf;
66:         let file_buf;
67:         let not_file = filename == OsStr::new("-");
68: 
69:         let mut file = BufReader::new(if not_file {
70:             stdin_buf = stdin();
71:             Box::new(stdin_buf) as Box<dyn Read>
72:         } else if filename.is_dir() {
73:             show!(USimpleError::new(
74:                 1,
75:                 format!("{}: Is a directory", filename.display())
76:             ));
77:             continue;
78:         } else {
79:             file_buf = match File::open(filename) {
80:                 Ok(opened) => {
81:                     if let Ok(meta) = opened.metadata() {
82:                         if meta.is_dir() {
83:                             show!(USimpleError::new(
84:                                 1,
85:                                 format!("{}: Is a directory", filename.display())
86:                             ));
87:                             continue;
88:                         }
89:                     }
90:                     opened
91:                 }
92:                 Err(err) => {
93:                     show!(err.map_err_context(|| filename.to_string_lossy().to_string()));
94:                     continue;
95:                 }
96:             };
97:             Box::new(file_buf) as Box<dyn Read>
98:         });
99: 
100:         let (sum_hex, sz) = {
101:             options.digest.reset();
102:             let binary_mode = false;
103:             let mut total_bytes: usize = 0;
104:             let mut read_buffer = [0u8; 8192];
105:             {
106:                 let mut digest_writer =
107:                     uucore::sum::DigestWriter::new(&mut options.digest, binary_mode);
108:                 loop {
109:                     match file.read(&mut read_buffer) {
110:                         Ok(0) => break,
111:                         Ok(bytes_read) => {
112:                             let chunk = &read_buffer[..bytes_read];
113:                             digest_writer
114:                                 .write_all(chunk)
115:                                 .map_err_context(|| "failed to read input".to_string())?;
116:                             total_bytes += bytes_read;
117:                         }
118:                         Err(ref interrupt_err)
119:                             if interrupt_err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted =>
120:                         {
121:                             continue;
122:                         }
123:                         Err(read_err) => {
124:                             return Err(
125:                                 read_err.map_err_context(|| "failed to read input".to_string())
126:                             );
127:                         }
128:                     }
129:                 }
130:                 digest_writer.finalize();
131:             }
132: 
133:             let digest_hex = if options.digest.output_bits() > 0 {
134:                 options.digest.result_str()
135:             } else {
136:                 let shake_byte_len = (options.output_bits + 7) / 8;
137:                 let mut shake_bytes = vec![0; shake_byte_len];
138:                 options.digest.hash_finalize(&mut shake_bytes);
139:                 hex::encode(shake_bytes)
140:             };
141:             (digest_hex, total_bytes)
142:         };
143: 
144:         let sum = match options.output_format {
145:             OutputFormat::Raw => {
146:                 let bytes = if options.algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC {
147:                     sum_hex.parse::<u32>().unwrap().to_be_bytes().to_vec()
148:                 } else if options.algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV
149:                     || options.algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD
150:                 {
151:                     sum_hex.parse::<u16>().unwrap().to_be_bytes().to_vec()
152:                 } else {
153:                     hex::decode(sum_hex).unwrap()
154:                 };
155:                 stdout().write_all(&bytes)?;
156:                 return Ok(());
157:             }
158:             OutputFormat::Hexadecimal => sum_hex,
159:             OutputFormat::Base64 => {
160:                 if options.algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC
161:                     || options.algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV
162:                     || options.algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD
163:                 {
164:                     sum_hex
165:                 } else {
166:                     let raw_bytes = hex::decode(&sum_hex).unwrap();
167:                     encoding::encode(encoding::Format::Base64, &raw_bytes).unwrap()
168:                 }
169:             }
170:         };
171:         // The BSD checksum output is 5 digit integer
172:         let bsd_width = 5;
173:         match (options.algo_name, not_file) {
174:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV, true) => println!(
175:                 "{} {}",
176:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
177:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits)
178:             ),
179:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV, false) => println!(
180:                 "{} {} {}",
181:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
182:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits),
183:                 filename.display()
184:             ),
185:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD, true) => println!(
186:                 "{:0bsd_width$} {:bsd_width$}",
187:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
188:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits)
189:             ),
190:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD, false) => println!(
191:                 "{:0bsd_width$} {:bsd_width$} {}",
192:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
193:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits),
194:                 filename.display()
195:             ),
196:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC, true) => println!("{sum} {sz}"),
197:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC, false) => println!("{sum} {sz} {}", filename.display()),
198:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B, _) if options.tag => {
199:                 if let Some(length) = options.length {
200:                     // Multiply by 8 here, as we want to print the length in bits.
201:                     println!("BLAKE2b-{} ({}) = {sum}", length * 8, filename.display());
202:                 } else {
203:                     println!("BLAKE2b ({}) = {sum}", filename.display());
204:                 }
205:             }
206:             _ => {
207:                 if options.tag {
208:                     println!(
209:                         "{} ({}) = {sum}",
210:                         options.algo_name.to_ascii_uppercase(),
211:                         filename.display()
212:                     );
213:                 } else {
214:                     let prefix = if options.asterisk { "*" } else { " " };
215:                     println!("{sum} {prefix}{}", filename.display());
216:                 }
217:             }
218:         }
219:     }
220: 
221:     Ok(())
222: }

242: /// Determines whether to prompt an asterisk (*) in the output.
243: ///
244: /// This function checks the `tag`, `binary`, and `had_reset` flags and returns a boolean
245: /// indicating whether to prompt an asterisk (*) in the output.
246: /// It relies on the overrides provided by clap (i.e., `--binary` overrides `--text` and vice versa).
247: /// Same for `--tag` and `--untagged`.
248: fn prompt_asterisk(tag: bool, binary: bool, had_reset: bool) -> bool {
249:     if tag {
250:         return false;
251:     }
252:     if had_reset {
253:         return false;
254:     }
255:     binary
256: }
257: 
258: /**
259:  * Determine if we had a reset.
260:  * This is basically a hack to support the behavior of cksum
261:  * when we have the following arguments:
262:  * --binary --tag --untagged
263:  * Don't do it with clap because if it struggling with the --overrides_with
264:  * marking the value as set even if not present
265:  */
266: fn had_reset(args: &[String]) -> bool {
267:     // Indices where "--binary" or "-b", "--tag", and "--untagged" are found
268:     let binary_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--binary" || x == "-b");
269:     let tag_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--tag");
270:     let untagged_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--untagged");
271: 
272:     // Check if all arguments are present and in the correct order
273:     match (binary_index, tag_index, untagged_index) {
274:         (Some(b), Some(t), Some(u)) => b < t && t < u,
275:         _ => false,
276:     }
277: }
278: 
279: /***
280:  * cksum has a bunch of legacy behavior.
281:  * We handle this in this function to make sure they are self contained
282:  * and "easier" to understand
283:  */
284: fn handle_tag_text_binary_flags(matches: &clap::ArgMatches) -> UResult<(bool, bool)> {
285:     let untagged: bool = matches.get_flag(options::UNTAGGED);
286:     let tag: bool = matches.get_flag(options::TAG);
287:     let tag: bool = tag || !untagged;
288: 
289:     let binary_flag: bool = matches.get_flag(options::BINARY);
290: 
291:     let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
292:     let had_reset = had_reset(&args);
293: 
294:     let asterisk: bool = prompt_asterisk(tag, binary_flag, had_reset);
295: 
296:     Ok((tag, asterisk))
297: }

299: #[uucore::main]
300: pub fn uumain(args: impl uucore::Args) -> UResult<()> {
301:     let matches = uu_app().try_get_matches_from(args)?;
302: 
303:     let check = matches.get_flag(options::CHECK);
304: 
305:     let algo_name: &str = match matches.get_one::<String>(options::ALGORITHM) {
306:         Some(v) => v,
307:         None => {
308:             if check {
309:                 // if we are doing a --check, we should not default to crc
310:                 ""
311:             } else {
312:                 ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC
313:             }
314:         }
315:     };
316: 
317:     if ["bsd", "crc", "sysv"].contains(&algo_name) && check {
318:         return Err(ChecksumError::AlgorithmNotSupportedWithCheck.into());
319:     }
320: 
321:     let input_length = matches.get_one::<usize>(options::LENGTH);
322: 
323:     let length = match input_length {
324:         Some(length) => {
325:             if algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B {
326:                 calculate_blake2b_length(*length)?
327:             } else {
328:                 return Err(ChecksumError::LengthOnlyForBlake2b.into());
329:             }
330:         }
331:         None => None,
332:     };
333: 
334:     if check {
335:         let text_flag = matches.get_flag(options::TEXT);
336:         let binary_flag = matches.get_flag(options::BINARY);
337:         let strict = matches.get_flag(options::STRICT);
338:         let status = matches.get_flag(options::STATUS);
339:         let warn = matches.get_flag(options::WARN);
340:         let ignore_missing = matches.get_flag(options::IGNORE_MISSING);
341:         let quiet = matches.get_flag(options::QUIET);
342: 
343:         if binary_flag || text_flag {
344:             return Err(ChecksumError::BinaryTextConflict.into());
345:         }
346:         // Determine the appropriate algorithm option to pass
347:         let algo_option = if algo_name.is_empty() {
348:             None
349:         } else {
350:             Some(algo_name)
351:         };
352: 
353:         // Execute the checksum validation based on the presence of files or the use of stdin
354: 
355:         let files = matches.get_many::<String>(options::FILE).map_or_else(
356:             || iter::once(OsStr::new("-")).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
357:             |files| files.map(OsStr::new).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
358:         );
359:         return perform_checksum_validation(
360:             files.iter().copied(),
361:             strict,
362:             status,
363:             warn,
364:             binary_flag,
365:             ignore_missing,
366:             quiet,
367:             algo_option,
368:             length,
369:         );
370:     }
371: 
372:     let (tag, asterisk) = handle_tag_text_binary_flags(&matches)?;
373: 
374:     let algo = detect_algo(algo_name, length)?;
375: 
376:     let output_format = if matches.get_flag(options::RAW) {
377:         OutputFormat::Raw
378:     } else if matches.get_flag(options::BASE64) {
379:         OutputFormat::Base64
380:     } else {
381:         OutputFormat::Hexadecimal
382:     };
383: 
384:     let opts = Options {
385:         algo_name: algo.name,
386:         digest: (algo.create_fn)(),
387:         output_bits: algo.bits,
388:         length,
389:         tag,
390:         output_format,
391:         asterisk,
392:     };
393: 
394:     match matches.get_many::<String>(options::FILE) {
395:         Some(files) => cksum(opts, files.map(OsStr::new))?,
396:         None => cksum(opts, iter::once(OsStr::new("-")))?,
397:     };
398: 
399:     Ok(())
400: }

404:         .version(crate_version!())
405:         .about(ABOUT)
406:         .override_usage(format_usage(USAGE))
407:         .infer_long_args(true)
